published_prior_art.cite: BertsimasPopescu2005 + BayerTeichmann2006: general moment duality and atomic compression, but not the compatible hierarchical-SCM reduction.
HalasehMagronSkomra2026 + BayerTeichmann2006: relative-interior dual attainment and finite cubature are known general tools; the four-cell causal fiber and endpoint SCM interpretation are new.
HalasehMagronSkomra2026: supplies the full-support/strict-feasibility ingredient, while the residual perturbation separates this rational causal functional.
Wood1999BinomialMixtures: fixed-plate mixing-law aliasing, not nonmembership of the four-cell ATE integrand in the Bernstein span.
Wood1999BinomialMixtures: fixed-order mixture nonidentification is established; the functional-span formulation and strict interior ATE-width consequence specialize it to the causal target.
Wood1999BinomialMixtures: boundary/representation geometry is known, but this Dirac-fiber consequence for the causal ATE fiber is a specialization.
LeeWeidner2026 gives particular valid limited-pooling envelopes, not an all-valid-envelope contact-hull equality criterion with separate open strict-improvement regions.
LeeWeidner2026 proves validity of its order-m envelopes; it does not compare them to the sharp unrestricted mixing-law fiber.

DuarteFinkelsteinKnoxMummoloShpitser2023 and EnglandBradfordDavenport2020 provide, respectively, discrete causal polynomial optimization and generic CAD, not exact continuous-latent hierarchical-ATE certificates.
BasuBrillYekutieli2026 gives exact inversion for univariate mixing CDFs/quantiles; it does not give a semialgebraic confidence set for this multivariate sharp ATE fiber.
Exact test inversion and the union-inclusion coverage argument are standard; the proposition is appropriately presented as a corollary rather than the novelty kernel.
Wood1999BinomialMixtures and HalasehMagronSkomra2026 leave the proposed multivariate causal boundary-fiber stratification open.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add one rational m=2 worked CAD certificate with explicit endpoint atoms and Bernstein dual coefficients; this turns the stated kill test into a reproducible exhibited object.
Give one explicit observable count law and reference propensity at which each Lee--Weidner endpoint is strictly looser, rather than relying only on nonempty-open-set existence.
Promote the varying-plate follow-on into a sharp sampling-frequency or width-rate frontier if flagship scope is desired; the present fixed-m result is appropriately field-tier.

recommended_next_step: Advance this field-tier proposal to Stage 0, retaining the m=2 exact CAD certificate as the first implementation kill test.
